## Findings
- claim-1: For \(m\ge1\), source-30 sets \(n=4m\), \(r=s=2m\), \(i=j=m\), obtains \(a=b=m\), and states the count \(\binom{2m}{m}\) only “according to Conjecture 4.10.” [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 938-955]
- claim-2: For each type-\(A\) bigrassmannian \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), there is \(w_{r,s,t,n}\) with \(J_v=I_w\) in the coinvariant algebra. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 675-683]
- claim-3: Put \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\), \(v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\), and \(w_m=w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\). Define \[ \mu_{A_m}(L)=\min\{|G|:G\subseteq L\text{ homogeneous and }L=A_mG\}. \] The parameter conditions hold: \(1\le m+1\le2m\le4m\) and \(m+1>2m+2m-4m=0\). Moreover \[ i=s-t+1=m,\quad j=r-t+1=m,\quad a=b=m. \] In the *same* graded ring \(A_m\), \[ J_{v_m}=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\} =\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\not\le w_m\}=I_{w_m}. \] Hence a homogeneous set generates \(J_{v_m}\) iff it generates \(I_{w_m}\), and therefore \[ \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}). \] Thus the source-30 reduction preserves generator number when both ideals are considered in \(A_m\).
- claim-4: No supplied accepted internal result states the required numerical theorem \[ \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\qquad(m\ge1). \] The supplied source instead labels this count conjectural.
## Strategy
For \(m\ge1\), set
\[
A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z),\quad
v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m},\quad w_m=w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}.
\]
Here \(1\le m+1\le2m\) and \(m+1>0=2m+2m-4m\). Thus
\[
i=s-t+1=m,\quad j=r-t+1=m,\quad a=b=m.
\]

Define
\[
\mu_{A_m}(L)=\min\{|G|:G\subseteq L\text{ homogeneous and }L=A_mG\}.
\]
The integral Schubert classes form a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(A_m\). Since \(w_m\) is the dissector associated to \(v_m\), the Bruhat-index sets satisfy
\[
u\ge v_m\iff u\not\le w_m.
\]
Consequently, as literal homogeneous ideals in the same integral graded ring,
\[
J_{v_m}
=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v_m\}
=\mathbb Z\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\not\le w_m\}
=I_{w_m}.
\]
Therefore every homogeneous generating set of one is exactly a homogeneous generating set of the other, and
\[
\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}).
\]
This proves generator-number preservation in \(A_m\), independently of source-30’s conjectural numerical statement.

## Gaps
No supplied internal theorem, indecomposables computation, or durable locator establishes
\[
\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})=\binom{2m}{m}\qquad(m\ge1).
\]
The supplied source-30 passage explicitly makes that number conditional on Conjecture 4.10 [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 942-955]. The internal ledger likewise records the requisite numerical theorem as unsupported. Inclusion-minimality of the displayed \(\binom{2m}{m}\)-element family would not suffice.

Hence the requested full certificate is **not established**; only the ambient-ring preservation equality is proved.

## Next
A valid completion requires an exact internal theorem or a proof that
\[
J_{v_m}/(A_m)_+J_{v_m}
\]
requires exactly \(\binom{2m}{m}\) abelian-group generators for every \(m\ge1\), thereby yielding the stated equality for \(\mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m})\).
